mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact circle residues for transmission moments, independent closed 2x2 eigenvector averages, uniform-transmission Beta mixture, rational unitary closure and scalar delay derivatives, and sampling normalization.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q(i), rational residues and exact symbolic algebra.
mathematics.conventions: Y=J/(1+J), J=T/|1-dw|^2; source eigenvector selection weighted by its squared source component; ordered distinct marked ports.
inputs: Two rational rotation transmissions, powers 1..8, independent eigenvector and scattering residues.
Prescribed rational unitaries of size 2,3,4 and every ordered source/target pair.
Three rational intensity vectors including one with a zero weight, three test functions.
non_claims: No asymptotic Porter-Thomas input is proved.
Finite controls do not certify the complete analytic proof.
No BGS solution or novelty assertion.
